results.title: Kîzîm
results.overview: Kîzîm is a 2025/2026 Romanian drama film directed by Radu Potcoavă, exploring the conflict between tradition and love within the Tatar community in South-Eastern Romania. The story follows 15-year-old Selda (Yeliz Mustafa) as she navigates teenage life, love for a Christian boy, and her family's strict, traditional expectations.

results.title: Cyberfuck
results.overview: A feature length satirical documentary-musical about the true history of the World Wide Web. Featuring drag queens and re-edited instructional VHS tapes, hacking AI, the “end of history”, and the colonization of cyberspace.

results.title: Project Baby
results.overview: The story follows Sandy, a 30-something advertising executive who, fearing her biological clock is ticking, launches "Project Baby"—a step-by-step mission to conceive a child on her own terms with a no-strings-attached donor. She selects Migo, a sensitive artist, but quickly realizes that meticulous plans can't account for human emotion.

results.title: Valentin's Day
results.overview: Valentin has to face rather unusual roadblocks on a way to celebrate the 14th with his girlfriend.

results.title: Street Fighters
results.overview: The world’s best martial artists come together for a world championship organised by a mysterious organisation. As alliances are forged and enemies emerge, they soon realise there’s more at stake than the grand prize… their lives!

results.title: Avemmaria
results.overview: Felice lives in two dark rooms of a crumbling building with his father Raffaele, recently laid off, his mother Antonietta, too young and worn down by grief, his grandmother Filomena, always dressed in black and filled with resentment, and three brothers, with another on the way. In that world of poverty and violence, a boy like him can either be crushed or cling to his dreams. His imagination is his refuge, but in Pianura there's no room for fantasy - being poor and a dreamer is a fault. Yet his teacher, Giulia, recognizes his singing talent and tries to offer him new horizons. When Felice sees Neil Armstrong's footprint in his textbook, he realizes he too might leave Pianura and reach the moon.

results.title: Tin Castle
results.overview: Along a long-forgotten road, the O’Reillys live in a rundown trailer stranded in the middle of the fields. Pa’, Lisa, and their ten children weather the seasons in their tin castle, heirs to a way of life on borrowed time. Under threat of eviction, their tenuous balance falters, yet – steadfast in their tradition – they resist. The children laugh, the dogs bark, the trailer holds on – but for how long?

results.title: Segeljungs - Mit Null Ahnung um die Welt
results.original_title: Segeljungs - Mit Null Ahnung um die Welt
results.overview: Four Bavarians with no sailing experience decide to conquer the world's oceans. They are confronted with the untamed power of the sea, unexpected meetings and new challenges.

results.title: Pencils Down
results.overview: When a woman discovers her co-worker dead at the office, she must find an immediate replacement or risk losing her own job.

results.title: Faces
results.overview: Nitya grapples with post-traumatic stress disorder after her partner, Michael, vanishes. Consequently, she identifies his features in strangers while investigating the mystery of his disappearance.

results.title: Three Heroes. Daily Tales 3
results.original_title: Три богатыря. Ни дня без подвига 3

results.title: Marvelous Mornings
results.overview: At her grandmother's funeral, Charlie learns that she already has a place reserved in the family vault. In search of an escape, she herself delivers the crate of disco vinyls her grandmother left to the wine merchant in a village in the south of France. In the deserted seaside resort, the records bring back bitter memories of lost loves. Here, time has a different value, and people are more bored than busy. Charlie only has eyes for Marina, the waitress at the pizzeria. Nothing predestined clumsy, overly sincere Charlie and wounded tornado Marina to mend fences together. But sometimes destiny reunites lost mermaids.

results.title: PAINT SPLATTER!
results.overview: Sam Stanicky looks up to and wants to be like his grandfather. His father, Jackson, isn't so approving though.

results.title: Who Could Kill a Sweet Old Lady
results.original_title: Who Could Kill a Sweet Old Lady
results.overview: When Edie becomes the new caregiver to an extremely rich elderly woman, she soon starts to suspect that someone wants her client dead - and that she's now the only thing standing in their way.

results.title: Edward Said: Between Worlds
results.overview: An all archival documentary that chronicles the personal journey and ideas of Palestinian-American intellectual, Edward Said.

results.title: Spring in Imroz
results.overview: The narrative follows the emotional journey of two distinct individuals whose paths unexpectedly cross on the island, forcing them to confront the heavy shadows of their pasts while discovering the profound possibility of a "second spring" or love being reborn.

results.title: RUNNER
results.overview: A young drug dealer has to evade two police officers whilst getting ready to have dinner with his girlfriend's parents for the first time

results.title: The Exit State
results.overview: In the not-too-distant future, a group of American citizens attempt to flee the country to escape an authoritarian regime, but their path to freedom quickly becomes a dystopian nightmare.

results.title: The Ocean Between Them
results.overview: A family vacation in Belize turns into a nightmare when a sudden storm strands a young kayaker named Miranda at sea, prompting her mother, Joan, to launch a desperate search.

results.title: Lockdown
results.overview: During a national emergency, Anita finds herself isolated at home while facing personal challenges. As she adapts to the new reality, an unexpected situation tests her resilience and changes her perspective on life.
